triggers.filterCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var hidan = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === self.ownerId; }); if (!hidan) return false; if (!ctx.piece || ctx.piece.instanceId !== hidan.instanceId) return false; return !!(hidan.statusTags && hidan.statusTags.some(function(t) { return t.type === 'hidan-dying'; })); }
triggers.effectCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var hidan = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === self.ownerId; }); if (!hidan) return { success: false }; return { success: true, blocked: true, message: hidan.name + '处于濒死状态，免疫伤害' }; }
